messages:
kevin-peopleops: Quick question re: midyear add. Employee got married in Brazil, uploaded a scanned marriage cert (Portuguese) but no apostille. They're also changing their last name and want payroll to update before next cycle. What do we accept for benefits + payroll?
nina-benefits: Brazil uses apostille for international use. For benefits we need either an apostille OR a consulate-verified copy + certified English translation. If they can't get apostille immediately we can provisionally enroll spouse for up to 30 days while docs are pending, but payroll name changes are separate.
jordan-payroll: For payroll name changes we need the SSA-89 or SSA name change confirmation AND either passport or marriage certificate with apostille/consulate verification. Payroll can't update legal name for tax/SSN without SSA evidence. If they want paychecks under new name but legal name not updated, we can add a preferred name on payroll profile but tax docs remain the legal name.
kevin-peopleops: Employee is on parental leave right now and wants benefit coverage to start retro to QLE date. Any blockers?
lisa-hr: Parental leave doesn't block QLE processing. Retro coverage to the QLE date is fine if docs come in within 30 days. For retro payroll adjustments we need the SSN/ITIN and payroll attestation.
nina-benefits: Upload checklist to give employee: 
``n1) Benefits Portal > Documents > Add Dependent
2) Upload original marriage certificate (scan) + certified English translation
3) Upload apostille OR consular verification from Brazilian consulate
4) If changing legal name: start SSA/process for name change and upload SSA confirmation
5) Add SSN/ITIN when available
6) In notes write: "QLE - provisionally enrolled pending docs"
```
jordan-payroll: Operational note: if they provide consulate verification now and SSA confirmation later, we can process benefits immediately and schedule payroll legal-name update on receipt of SSA docs. Please have employee sign the payroll attestation for provisional processing so deductions are set correctly.
kevin-peopleops: I'll send the checklist. If apostille turnaround is slow, does HR assist with consulate contacts?
lisa-hr: Yes - ping me and I'll share expedited consulate options and a template attestation letter for the employee to take to the consulate.
benefits-bot: Reminder: QLE changes must be filed within 30 days for automatic retro coverage. See policy: https://intranet.redwood/benefits/qle
kevin-peopleops: Thanks all. I'll coordinate with the employee and tag you if we need an extension or escalations.
